posts.text: Announcing a new Claude Code feature: Remote Control. It's rolling out now to Max users in research preview. Try it with /remote-control. Start local sessions from the terminal, then continue them from your phone. Take a walk, see the sun, walk your dog without losing your flow.
posts.notes: Remote Control launch by Claude Code PM. 4.47M views, 8,256 bookmarks. Start terminal sessions, continue from phone. Rolling out to Max users. Direct relevance: async agent control from mobile is the exact pattern needed for L-Thread remote orchestration.
